meta.name: Shrikant Bashir Hindi
meta.description:
Shrikant Bashir is an edgy action-drama series that showcases the partnership of two ideologically & ethnically different individuals working for the Surgical Operation Team (SOT) a premium intelligence agency to solve crimes of national threat. SOT is led by the dynamic duo Shrikant Mahatre and Bashir Khan, who cannot see eye to eye. Through the series, we see how these two contrasting personalities come together bending their personal differences for the greater good of the nation.

Ended · First aired 10 Dec 2020 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Banijay Asia, Salman Khan Television · Network: SonyLIV

Complete series. On your server: S1 26/26

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: The Stolen Codes
videos.overview: The country is in great danger since a terrorist group decides to steal the Nuclear Missile Codes from India.

videos.title: A Tragic Twist
videos.overview: The codes can be accessed only through Neel's retina. Mahopatra, an MLA is involved in this deal. Meanwhile Neel's dead body has to be delivered to Samarullah (commander Hafizullah's brother) for the exchange of the codes. Shrikant takes the task at hand and the SOT tries to stop the deal. In a Shoot-out Jasmine and Zain are taken down, Samarullah get's gravely injured. The codes are in safe hands?

videos.title: The Scam
videos.overview: SOT comes to know that Samarullah has gone into a coma. Meanwhile, Mahopatra informs Hafizullah about Samarullah. Kiran Gandhi gets arrested for a bank fraud. Shrikant gets appointed as SOT's new interim chief. Kiran Gandhi exposes Jignesh Parekh in the court about the fraud. Jignesh Parker hires Parker, an international criminal to murder the Gandhi Brothers. While rescuing Jayesh Gandhi the SOT and Parker have a face-off. But a new twist awaits the SOT.

videos.title: Welcome To The Lion's Den
videos.overview: Parker's henchman Roy has successfully abducted Jayesh Gandhi. During the chase, the SOT captures Parker. Bank Manager Ramakant is worried about Jayesh Gandhi's statement in court while Jignesh Parekh is not affected at all. Meanwhile Carla decides to surprise Shrikant at his flat. Parker smartly manages to escape the SOT office, and while he is on the run, he shoots Raveena. Has the SOT lost one of their core members? Will Jayesh Gandhi be able to give his statement?

videos.title: Cheers
videos.overview: Parker goes straight to his warehouse where Jayesh Gandhi is a hostage and then shot dead by Parker. In the hospital, his daughter Meenal hands a pen-drive to Shrikant with all the information of the bank fraud. Meanwhile Jignesh Parekh hires a hacker, Titan to hack Markand Cooperative Bank. Has the case not been solved yet? Will SOT be able to track the hacker and Jignesh Parekh?

videos.title: The Trojan Horse
videos.overview: The SOT has now shifted their focus to the Markand CooperativeBank where Lavesh Sahni bank IT Head gives them the details about the ransomware. Unfortunately Lavesh's family is captured by Roy and his men. Shrikant and Mahopatra make a deal to free Samurallah before the interrogation. SOT rescues Lavesh's family. Shrikant proves his intelligence yet again by getting Ramakant and Jignesh arrested. Although, Parker is still free and plotting his next mission. How Shrikant Bashir will get catch hold of Parker?

videos.title: Evil: The Genesis
videos.overview: Dr. Sajeev Mahajan and his assistants Murli and Sridhar creates an antidote of Ebola virus. But his assistants betray him and steal the antidotes for Narang. Who then signs a deal with Rohit Kaura (owner of Aarkay Pharamaceuticals). Dr Sukheja, Kaura's R&D Head is the only man to carry the antidote in his body. Meanwhile, the Commander Hafizuallah and Parker have made a deal to spread the virus in India. Can the SOT trace them ? Or will it be too late ?

videos.title: A Sting Operation
videos.overview: Parker and Hafizullah question Murli and Sridhar regarding the antidote and shoot them knowing that it can be made again and SOT is unable to track them. Meanwhile Bashir and Madan are into a sting operation against Shrikant. Shrikant gets a tragic call, while Sukheja has arrived in Mumbai. Much to our surprise, a cross deal takes place between Narang and Parker to spread the virus.

videos.title: Hunt The Hunter
videos.overview: Shrikant and Bashir is chasing Amit Kaura and Robbie and finally catch hold of Robbie at the airport, silmultaenouly Dr. Sukheja gets kidnapped. Robbie confesses to the SOT. At the Delhi airport lounge Narang is about to spread the virus. Is the country about to witness an outbreak? Is the SOT already too late to trace the virus?

videos.title: First Victim
videos.overview: Dr. Abodh Chatterji and the Commissioner arrive at the SOT office to brief the team about Ebola virus. Ajit and Chandrika leave for Delhi, to capture Amit. Parker and Danny arrive at Mumbai. Just when Amit is about to escape, Chandrika and Ajit catch hold of him. At the Delhi airport Narang and Roma squirt the virus in Nelson's drink. Will Ajit, Chandrika, Amit along with Nelson now face a mid-air Ebola breakout. How are they going to control the situaton?

videos.title: Catch Me If You Can
videos.overview: Shrikant and Bashir gets to know about Rohit Kaura's deal, and they reach his office to interrogate him. Narang informs Rohit about releasing the virus. Raveena, Bashir and Shrikant try to decrypt Rohit Kaura's phone. Meanwhile the African man's health completely deteriorates in the flight. Chandrika and Dr. Kunal inform Dr. Abodh about the breakout. But to everyone's surprise, Rohit Kaura switches his phone off and manipulates the SOT into thinking that he has eloped in his chopper. Has Shrikant Bashir just been tricked?

videos.title: The Karma
videos.overview: Rohit Kaura reaches the Vasai factory for the deal with Samson. The antidote is extracted from Sukheja's body and starts the production of antidote. Meanwhile, an emergency landing of an aircraft is done as most of the passengers got infected with Ebola virus. The SOT arrests Rohit Kaura. While Parker is on his way to kidnap Sukheja, Rohit Kaura comes to know that his son too, is a victim of the ebola virus as he is in the same aircraft.

videos.title: ROF - RIng Of Fire
videos.overview: As soon as the Shrikant and team reaches Vasai Factory, its in Shambles. A blast takes place, Balraj Chadda is on fire. Who is the real culprit behind this? SOT is unable to save Balraj. Meanwhile, Hafizullah plans a big move. After Rohit Kaura's arrest, Shalini Kaura takes the matter in her own hands. In search of the antidote the SOT ends up in Samson's gym where they find a phone using which Raveena tracks Parker. which leads them in mall. Will the Shrikant hunt Parker down? How will the passengers at the Hangar pull through?

videos.title: The Ultimate Chase
videos.overview: Shrikant Bashir manages to find out that it was Parker behind Dr. sukheja's kidnapping. Carla gets worried about the patients, since their condition seems to worsen. The SOT figures out that it was Narang who infected Nelson with the virus. Shalini Kaura manages to get her hands on the ebola antidote. Roma and Narang meet Rajiv Bhatia (Parker's dealer) at the club in exchange of the antidote. They escape right under Shrikant Bashir nose, but unfortunately a man dies.

videos.title: The Apocalypse
videos.overview: Parker releases ebola virus in mumbai lake. Samarullah gains back his consciousness but he is paralyzed. The relatives of the infected passengers are now allowed to meet their families, meanwhile the Commissioner calls Sujit, The Chief of Bureau of Anti-Terrorism to help SOT with the case. Roma gains consious. While the SOT tries to interrogate Roma in the ambulance, an accident takes place and Parker shoots Roma and she drops dead. Will the SOT be able to figure out who is behind this master plan and get the antidote in time?

videos.title: The Mastermind
videos.overview: Shalini Kaura sneaks in the ebola antidote. Narang and Rajeev bhatia caught in the act. Nurse Nancy quietly injects the ebola antidote in Amit Kaura's body. We see a cold war taking place between Shrikant and Sujit Rawal. Shrikant and Bashir lay a trap for Shalini. Will she get caught or manages to escape?

videos.title: Tryst With Destiny
videos.overview: Dr. Abodh Chatterjee recalls his first conversation with Rohit Kaura about how they brought this plan to life. The SOT becomes cautious of the tempo standing outside the office, Parker who keeps an eye on the proceedings activates the explosive. Carla and Chandrika figure out that the ebola strain in Amit's body has reduced but on the other hand virus spreads in the city. SOT on the chase but another man dead, will Shrikant lose another clue, or will they have the right direction?

videos.title: Lockdown
videos.overview: Shrikant and Bashir gives surprise visit to Mrs. Kaura. CM decides to hold a press conference and inform the citizens about the virus. Meanwhile Parker, Dr. Abodh, and Rajiv Bhatia are planning for another heinous crime. Shrikant cracks Parkers game. The SOT, CM and the Commissioner access the dark net site where Hafizullah places his cards on the table and offers the deal. What is going to be Shrikant's next move?

videos.title: A Quantum Leap
videos.overview: Shalini pays a visit to Rohit Kaura to inform him about Amit's demise. Meanwhile Hafizullah and his men have made a full-fledged plan to cross the Indian Borders. Sujit Rawal is no more just an advisor on this case. Shrikant Bashir gets a big breakthrough about Dr. Abodh and Rajiv Bhatia's past, which helps openup new doors for them.

videos.title: Ray Of Hope
videos.overview: Shrikant and Bashir executes surgical strike in a factory where they catch hold of Rajiv Bhatia. At the CM's office Shrikant and Bashir prove that Dr. Abodh has been the culprit, which gives hope another chance. Shrikant calls up the Bharat Medical Association Chief Dr. Bhaskar, explains the situation and the antidotes are distributed to the Hospitals. Meanwhile Parker gives Shrikant a job to do and should he fail, the consequences can be catastrophic. Meanwhile Hafizullah and his troop are well placed across the border. What will be the next strategy of Shrikant ...

videos.title: Under Arrest
videos.overview: In exchange for the antidote from the commander, Shrikant has to be the one to bring Samarullah back to his brother and a bitcoin ransom transaction must be made. Shrikant agrees to Parker's deal and the SOT plans a strategy. In a shocking turn of events Shrikant arrests Bashir. Shrikant then discusses the deal with Mahopatra. Hafizullah with the help of an Insider manages to cross the Zero line.

videos.title: Plan Of Action
videos.overview: Since Madan is bugged, Sujit Rawal and his PA eves drop on SOT's plan. Sujit Rawal heads towards Gaggal immediately. Mahopatra is taken into custody by Bashir for murder charges. Hafizullah's men successfully invade Rehalpura village and capture the village as hostage. The mission led by Shrikant Bashir is now put into action.

videos.title: Dead End
videos.overview: As Parker keeps instructing Shrikant, he manages to smartly manipulate him. Raveena coordinates with Bashir and Shrikant while Sujit too is following them. Parker gets to know Shrikants plan and in an act of rage ends up killing someone. Shrikant and Bashir through their own struggles manage to reach Bagdadi's warehouse. What they discover there is shocking.

videos.title: The Mission Unfolds
videos.overview: Madan's death has come in as a shock, while Shrikant, Bashir and Carla are still getting themselves together, there is an attack on the warehouse which leads into a massive shoot out. Parker gets away with Carla and Samarullah. Finally, Hafizullah meets his brother Samarullah. Sujit Rawal steps down. Due to the series of unfortunate events, SOT has to revise their plan entirely. Will their plan be any good or will they fail in the hands of the terrorist group.

videos.title: Surgical Strike
videos.overview: While Parker thinks Bashir is abiding by his rules, he is busy manipulating him once again. Bashir agrees to exchange the bitcoins only if he gets to test the Antidote. And much to everyone's surprise the antidote is fake. And Bashir breaks the news to everyone that the antidote has already been distributed amongst everyone. Shrikant and Officer Gupta are entering the village from all sides. This is a surgical strike on the terrorist group that threatened to wipe out not only Mumbai but the whole country with the Ebola Virus. Country applauds for Shrikant and team but...
